post.title: **Hybrid Logical Clocks: The Invisible Timekeeper for Causal Consistency**
post.subtitle: *TLDR: 🕰️ Hybrid Logical Clocks (HLCs) let each node locally stamp writes, preserving causal order across regions while keeping clocks simple. Without HLCs, you risk lost causality or heavy clock sync.
